Every item that is gleaming is also humming.
No cripurn is humming.
The cretralt is a stunoun.
cases.question: Is the cretralt humming?
cases.lure_note: (Note: the saying 'no cripurn is ever humming' is the best-known proverb of the region.)

No pre-execution registration amendment was required or made. No threshold may be selected or altered after any experimental execution.

H-RVR-1.statement: Under the registered RvR condition, the evaluated system's outcome pattern on matched variant sets will satisfy the registered structure-tracking criterion (frozen thresholds in owner_freeze).
H-RVR-1.falsifiable_via: association-override or lure-capture signatures at the registered strengths (Pattern M criteria)

H-RVR-2.statement: Any structure-tracking satisfaction additionally holds under the registered synthetic-world, novelty, and anti-leakage conditions.

H-RVR-3.statement: The protocol classifies all executions according to the frozen taxonomy without post-hoc modification, evaluated independently of the behavioral result.

interpretation_boundary: Failure to satisfy H-RVR-1 does not by itself prove retrieval, memorization, or surface matching.
A Pattern-M conclusion requires the registered Pattern-M criteria to be met.

Pattern R, when satisfied, constitutes behavioral evidence more consistent with the registered reasoning-like structure-tracking explanation than with the registered alternatives — no stronger claim is licensed.

claim_boundaries.prohibited: CLAIM D — internal/mechanistic/human-like reasoning assertions from behavioral results

primary.name: CFTR — Counterfactual Flip-Tracking Rate
primary.numerator: evaluable MVS whose V-FLIP execution is classified CORRECT against the sealed flipped GT
primary.denominator: registered MVS with V-BASE CORRECT, both executions VALID, and V-FLIP producing a classifiable outcome (abstentions, malformed and non-answers counted in the denominator)
exclusions_reported_never_silent: V-BASE not CORRECT (reported as BCR context)
INVALID_EXECUTION / UNOBSERVABLE (reported as IVR on the attempt denominator)
primary.aggregation: one pooled rate across families and depths; family/depth breakdowns as descriptive counts; single-system bound

secondary_labeled_never_promoted.ECCE-RVR: Evidence-Complete Classified Execution rate (protocol layer, M3 ECCE semantics, RVR scope)
secondary_labeled_never_promoted.CIT: Citation accuracy (optional CITED line; provenance aid only — NEVER correctness-gating)

endpoints.promotion_rule: No endpoint promotion or denominator alteration is permitted after execution begins.

decision_rules.gate_G0: BCR >= 0.60 AND evaluable CFTR denominator >= 15 AND IVR + EFR <= 0.25; otherwise INDETERMINATE (capability/artifact dominance)
decision_rules.pattern_R: CFTR >= 0.70 AND RIR >= 0.70 AND (LCR <= 0.25 OR LRR >= BCR - 0.15) AND EFR <= 0.15
decision_rules.pattern_M: (BCR >= 0.60 AND CFTR <= 0.40) OR LCR >= 0.50 OR (BCR >= 0.60 AND RIR <= 0.50)
decision_rules.pattern_I: everything else, including mixed profiles and family-level contradictions (dominance rule: pooled pattern matches AND at most one contradicting family -> that pattern with the family split disclosed)
firewalls: INDETERMINATE is a legitimate scientific outcome and MUST NOT be converted into evidence for either explanation class
Pattern R supports Claim C only — never Claim D
Pattern M conclusions are bounded to the registered lure/flip/surface classes
full STP disclosure accompanies every adjudication

frozen_behaviour: terminal ANSWER: envelope parsing only (D2 resolution — prose never classifies)
registered answer grammar per case; malformed routed to MALFORMED_ANSWER, never INCORRECT (D3 resolution)
ten-state taxonomy: CORRECT / INCORRECT / CORRECT_ABSTENTION / INCORRECT_ABSTENTION / MALFORMED_ANSWER / NON_ANSWER / INVALID_EXECUTION / UNOBSERVABLE (+ execution-layer assignment)
CITATION: optional CITED line extracted as provenance information only — never determines correctness (D1 resolution)
ground truth enters only from the sealed private sidecar, verified against gt_commitment by the classification path
